description: This file defines a mock class 'GstGenericPlayerFactoryMock' for unit testing, which implements the 'IGstGenericPlayerFactory' interface. It includes mock method creation for 'createGstGenericPlayer' using Google Mock, and references external interfaces and classes related to GStreamer media playback.

classes.name: GstGenericPlayerFactoryMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGstGenericPlayerFactory interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: createGstGenericPlayer
methods.description: A mock method to simulate creation of a GstGenericPlayer instance, taking client, decryption service, media type, video requirements, and a wrapper factory as parameters.
